sn48.12:1.1: In this and following discourses the concern shifts from definition to spiritual potential or capacity. We see who possesses the faculties, and understand how their development relates to the stages of realization.
sn48.12:1.5: Even the least of those on the path to stream-entry possess all five faculties to some degree. For the follower of teachings and follower by faith, see SN 25.1 and notes.
